randomness: all stochastic sources must be seeded from the cell seed and recorded
tie_policy: stable input order followed by first index for exact argmin/argmax ties; no undocumented random tie break
verification_gate: pilot must record interpreter and package versions and pass deterministic replay before formal execution
known_legacy_limit: the prior host ABI could not execute new pymoo 0.6.2 fronts with its moocore dependency; no alternate pymoo version may be silently substituted
